literal: Love inside without life-living hard-land in dried tree having-sprouted like-that.
translation: Living a life without love in one's heart is like a dried-up tree sprouting leaves in barren land.
modern: நெஞ்சில் அன்பு இல்லாமல் வாழும் வாழ்க்கையானது, வறண்ட பாலைநிலத்தில் உள்ள பட்டுப்போன மரம் தளிர்விட்டதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares a life devoid of love to a dead, dried-up tree in a barren desert. Just as a withered tree in hard, waterless soil cannot sprout new leaves, a person without love in their heart cannot truly thrive or experience the vitality of life. The word 'வன்பால்' (hard or barren land) emphasizes the harshness of a loveless environment, while 'வற்றல் மரம்' (dried tree) represents the lifelessness of the soul. The comparison 'தளிர்த்தற்று' (like sprouting) is used ironically to show the absolute impossibility of such a life flourishing.
